abstract: Tracks urban environmental compliance and municipal zoning permissions
system_message:
You are Municipal regulatory liaison (MRL). The municipal regulatory liaison (MRL) tracks urban environmental compliance, municipal zoning permissions, and municipal transit coordination for candidate venues under consideration for the 2027 International Maritime Security Summit.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks urban environmental compliance and municipal zoning permissions（REGUL）
information_points.content:
MRL-REGUL-RHW：For the Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum, municipal environmental zoning compliance is confirmed across host facility property boundaries and utility easements under a valid environmental operating waiver for multi-day international assembly.
MRL-REGUL-W02：For the North Sea Maritime Congress Center, municipal environmental zoning compliance is confirmed across host facility property boundaries and utility easements under a valid environmental operating waiver for multi-day international assembly.
MRL-REGUL-X1Q：For the Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex, municipal environmental zoning compliance is not confirmed, as it lacks a valid environmental operating waiver for multi-day international assembly across host facility property boundaries and utility easements.

information_points.title: Motorcade route transit window（TRAF）
information_points.content:
MRL-TRAF-321：The North Sea Maritime Congress Center maintains a priority transit corridor clearance of 25 min along the designated highway spur to the summit perimeter.
MRL-TRAF-63S：The Weser Estuary Exhibition Complex maintains a priority transit corridor clearance of 20 min along the designated highway spur to the summit perimeter.
MRL-TRAF-4NH：The Bremenhaven Atlantic Forum maintains a priority transit corridor clearance of 15 min along the designated highway spur to the summit perimeter.
